title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Ground Connection May Overheat (629 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain Thomas Built Buses 2024-2025 Saf-T-Liner C2 and Saf-T-Liner C2 Jouley school buses.  The ground cable for the air conditioning system may have been improperly installed and overheat.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Ground Connection May Overheat (13 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain Thomas Built Buses 2025 Saf-T-Liner C2 transit buses.  The ground cable for the air conditioning system may have been improperly installed and overheat.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Loss of Steering Control from Tie Rod Failure (3,799 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2025 Freightliner 108SD, 114SD, Business Class M2, Cascadia and Western Star 47X vehicles.  The tie rod in the front axle may contain ball studs that have been incorrectly heat-treated, which can cause them to break, and result in tie rod failure.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Loss of Drive Power (94 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021 Jeep Wrangler and Jeep Gladiator vehicles that were previously remedied under NHTSA recall number 23V-116.  The software for the powertrain control module may cause an engine stall, which can result in a loss of drive power.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Seat May Not Lock into Upright Position//FMVSS 207 (2,852 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023 Dodge Challenger vehicles.  The left rear seat back may not lock in the upright position.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 207, "Seating Systems."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Seat May Not Lock into Upright Position//FMVSS 207 (898 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023 Dodge Charger vehicles.  The left rear seat back may not lock in the upright position.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 207, "Seating Systems."

title: General Motors, LLC: Incorrect Owners Manual in Glove Box/FMVSS 225 (22 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2024 Cadillac XT4 and Chevrolet Malibu vehicles.  The vehicles may have the wrong owner's manual in the glove box.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 225, "Child Restraint Anchorage Systems."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Starter Motor May Fail and Overheat (105,588 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC is recalling certain 2019-2020 X5, X7, 2020 3 Series Sedan, X6, 2020-2021 7 Series Sedan, 2020 8 Series Convertible, 8 Series Coupe, and 2020 8 Series Gran Coupe vehicles.  Please see the recall report for the complete list of models.  In the event the starter motor fails, repeated attempts to start the vehicle can cause the starter motor to overheat from an electrical overload.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Battery Cables May Overheat and Cause Fire (125 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Entegra Anthem, Aspire, Cornerstone, Reatta, and Reatta XL motorhomes.  The battery cables may not be the correct size, in the correct location, or they may be improperly tightened, which can cause an electrical short or allow the cables to overheat.

title: Doosan Bobcat North America, Inc.: Wheel May Detach from Loose Lug Nuts (127 affected)
summary: Doosan Bobcat North America, Inc. (Doosan) is recalling certain 2023 Bobcat PA185, and C185WD0-T4F portable compressor trailers.  The wheel lug nuts may be improperly tightened.

title: TAXA LLC: Freshwater Tank Can Detach (863 affected)
summary: TAXA LLC (TAXA) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Mantis trailers.  The gaskets and brackets could fail to stabilize the freshwater tank, allowing the tank to move and detach from the trailer.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Loss of Steering Control from Tie Rod Failure (17 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain replacement tie rods equipped with USK ball studs, part numbers A-13102E4737 and A-13102E4738.  The tie rod assemblies may contain ball studs that have been incorrectly heat-treated, which can cause them to break, and possibly result in tie rod failure.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Loss of Steering Control from Tie Rod Failure (23 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain replacement tie rods equipped with USK ball studs, part numbers A-13102E4737 and A-13102E4738.  The tie rod assemblies may contain ball studs that have been incorrectly heat-treated, which can cause them to break, and possibly result in tie rod failure.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Unsecured Air Bag Control Unit (7 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2021 and 2024 Titan vehicles.  The Air Bag Control Unit (ACU) may be missing a spacer, which can allow the fastener to loosen and result in an unsecured ACU.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Seating Capacity on Label/FMVSS 120 (20 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Freelander motorhomes.  The Federal Placard indicates 30 seat-belted positions in the rear, when the correct number of belted positions is 3.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other than Passenger Cars" and 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Missing Headlight Aim Marking/FMVSS 108 (1,119 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2024 Nissan Frontier vehicles.  The right-side headlight assemblies may have missing or illegible headlight aim markings, which can result in improperly aimed headlights.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Hyundai Motor America: Brake Lights Flash During Braking/FMVSS 108 (38,331 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2024 Hyundai Sonata vehicles.  The software for the brake lights may cause the brake lights to flash and not illuminate properly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Hyundai Motor America: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (1,488 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain Genesis 2024-2025 GV60 hybrid and 2025 GV80 vehicles.  The rearview camera display may shut off when the vehicle is driven in reverse.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Insufficient Welds on Child Seat Tethers/FMVSS 225 (243 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee L vehicles.  The child seat tether welds on the second-row seat back frame may be insufficient, which can reduce the seat's ability to properly restrain a child during a crash.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 225, "Child Restraint Anchorage Systems."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Obstructed Tail Lights/FMVSS 108 (27 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024 Jeep Wrangler vehicles.  The vehicles are equipped with incorrect tail lights that may be obstructed by the spare tire.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Loss of Drive Power from Damaged Wire Harness (141 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2025 Lexus UX300h vehicles.  Certain wires in the engine room wire harness that supply power to the motor generator electronic control unit (MG ECU) may become fractured and separate, which can result in a loss of power.

title: General Motors, LLC: Floor Mat May Trap Accelerator Pedal (27,793 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain Buick Envision all-weather floor mats with part number 85647097, that may have been installed in certain 2024 Buick Envision vehicles.  The accelerator pedal may become trapped under the floor mat, which can result in unintended acceleration.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Coolant Leak Inside EGR Module May Cause Fire (15 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC. (BMW) is recalling certain 540d xDrive vehicles that were previously repaired under recall number 22V-614.  The exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) cooler may leak internally, causing coolant to mix with diesel engine soot, which could result in smoldering particles and a melting intake manifold.

title: General Motors, LLC: Loss of Brakes from Unexpected ABS Activation (21,469 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Cadillac LYRIQ all-wheel drive vehicles.  The anti-lock brake system (ABS) may activate unexpectedly and release brake pressure in the vehicle's service brake system.

title: Ford Motor Company: Steering Column Assembled with Incorrect Bolt (1,902 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Transit vehicles.  The steering column intermediate shaft may have been secured to the steering gear pinion shaft with an incorrect bolt, which can result in the separation of steering components and cause a loss of steering control.

title: Ford Motor Company: Loss of Drive Power from Undetected Low Battery (757 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 Maverick vehicles previously repaired under recall number 24V-267.  The body and power train control modules may fail to detect a change in the 12-volt battery state of charge.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Incorrectly Routed Brake Hose May Leak (16 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2024 AMG GLB 35 4MATIC vehicles.  The brake hoses on the rear axle may have been improperly routed, which could allow chafing, and result in a brake fluid leak.

title: Ford Motor Company: Rear Suspension Knuckles May Fail (4,595 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 Mustang vehicles.  The rear suspension knuckles may have a casting defect that causes them to fail, which can result in a loss of vehicle handling and steering control.

title: Ford Motor Company: Windshield Wiper Motor May Fail (86,852 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Maverick, Ford Bronco Sport, and Mustang Mach-E vehicles.  The front windshield wiper motor may become inoperative, causing the wipers to fail.

title: Cruise LLC: Software May Cause Unexpected Braking (1,194 affected)
summary: Cruise LLC (Cruise) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (ADS) units equipped with software versions released prior to May 14, 2024.  The software may cause the vehicle to unexpectedly brake in cases where a vehicle or cyclist approaches the rear of the vehicle.

title: Ford Motor Company: Power Windows May Pinch/FMVSS 118 (70,483 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 Ranger and 2024 Lincoln Nautilus vehicles.  When closing the windows with the global closing feature, the windows may not automatically reverse after detecting an object.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 118, "Power-Operated Window Systems."

title: Ford Motor Company: Engine Failure May Cause Fire (85,238 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Explorer vehicles equipped with the Police Interceptor Utility Package.  In the event of an engine failure, engine oil and fuel vapor may be released into the engine compartment and accumulate near ignition sources such as hot engine or exhaust components, possibly resulting in an engine compartment fire.

title: Triple E Recreational Vehicles: Incorrectly Routed Propane Line May Leak (7 affected)
summary: Triple E Recreational Vehicles (Triple E) is recalling certain 2024 Triple E Unity U24RL, U24TB, U24FX, and U24MBL motorhomes.  The RVMP generator propane hose may be incorrectly routed too close to the generator exhaust, which can result in a fuel leak.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: Improperly Coated Fuel Lines May Leak (8,294 affected)
summary: Blue Bird Bus Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2018-2021 Vision school buses equipped with 6.8L gasoline engines.  The coating on the fuel lines may have been improperly applied, which can result in a fuel leak.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: Improperly Coated Fuel Lines May Leak (89 affected)
summary: Blue Bird Bus Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2018-2021 Vision transit buses equipped with 6.8L gasoline engines.  The coating on the fuel lines may have been improperly applied, which can result in a fuel leak.

title: LIVEWIRE EV, LLC: High Voltage Fuse May Cause a Loss of Drive Power (788 affected)
summary: LiveWire EV, LLC (LiveWire) is recalling certain 2024 S2 Del Mar and S2 Mulholland motorcycles.  The high voltage fuse may degrade and unexpectedly open, resulting in a loss of drive power.

title: Motiv Power Systems: HV Battery Shutdown Can Cause Loss of Drive Power (28 affected)
summary: Motiv Power Systems, Inc. (Motiv) is recalling certain 2021-2023 F-450 and 2020 F-59 school buses equipped with a Motiv Gen 5 EPIC powertrain.  The vehicle control software could misclassify a loss of isolation between the chassis and high voltage system, shutting down the high voltage (HV) batteries.

title: Motiv Power Systems: Damage to Wires can Cause Loss of Drive Power (6 affected)
summary: Motiv Power Systems, Inc. (Motiv) is recalling certain 2021-2023 E-450 school buses equipped with a Motiv Gen 5 EPIC powertrain.  The Controller Area Network (CAN) signal wires could contact the frame rail and become damaged, causing a loss of drive power.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Water Pump Connector May Short Circuit (720,796 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC. (BMW) is recalling certain 2012-2015 X1 sDrive28i, X1 xDrive28i, 2012-2016 Z4 sDrive28i, 528i, 528i xDrive, 328i, 328xi, 2016-2018 X5 xdrive 40e, 2014-2016 228i, 228xi, 428i, 428i xDrive, 328xi Gran Turismo, 2013-2017 X3 sDrive28i, X3 xDrive28i, 2015-2018 X4 xDrive28i, 2015-2016 428xi vehicles.  An improperly sealed electrical connector on the water pump may be exposed to water and short circuit.

title: Rosenbauer America: Lower Control Arm Retention Fasteners Can Fail (5 affected)
summary: Rosenbauer America (Rosenbauer) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Commander fire trucks equipped with certain independent front suspension assemblies.  The lower control arm retention bolts can become brittle and break after being tightened.

title: Heartland Recreational Vehicles, LLC: Improperly Vented Generator May Overheat (9 affected)
summary: Heartland Recreational Vehicles (Heartland) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Torque travel trailers, equipped with optional Onan 5.5 generators.  These generators may not be properly vented and allow the generator to overheat or prevent exhaust gas from escaping properly.

title: Cruiser RV: Improperly Vented Generator May Overheat (27 affected)
summary: Cruiser RV is recalling certain 2024-2025 Stryker travel trailers, equipped with optional Onan 5.5 generators.  These generators may not be properly vented and allow the generator to overheat or prevent exhaust gas from escaping properly.

title: SPL Parts Inc: Lower Control Arm Retention Fasteners Can Fail (1,000 affected)
summary: SPL Parts Inc (SPL) is recalling certain Front Suspension Lower Control Arm Kits equipped with replacement bolts.  The lower control arm retention bolts could become brittle and break after being tightened.

title: REV Recreation Group: Front Overhead Cabinet Detachment May Cause Crash (4,665 affected)
summary: REV Recreation Group (REV) is recalling certain 2019-2025 Holiday Rambler Admiral, 2018 Holiday Rambler Admiral XE, Fleetwood Storm, 2023-2025 Holiday Rambler Eclipse, Fleetwood Flex, 2018-2025 Fleetwood Flair, 2020-2024 Fleetwood Fortis, 2020-2025 Holiday Rambler Invicta, 2018-2023 Fleetwood Pace Arrow, and 2018-2019 Holiday Rambler Vacationer XE motorhomes, equipped with the HappiJac drop down bed option.  The front overhead cabinet fasteners can break, allowing the overhead cabinet to detach.

title: Kido Sports Co., Ltd: Helmets Can Loosen or Detach/FMVSS 218 (16,063 affected)
summary: Kido Sports Co., Ltd. (Kido Sports) is recalling certain Scorpion EXO-C90 and Harley-Davidson HD-X06 helmets, sizes XS, S, M, L, XL, and 2XL.  The helmets may not stay securely fastened during a crash.  As such, these helmets fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 218, "Motorcycle Helmets."

title: CFMOTO Powersports, Inc.: Throttle Wire May Break and Cause Engine Stall (850 affected)
summary: CFMOTO Powersports, Inc. (CFMOTO) is recalling certain 2023 Ibex 800 S and Ibex 800 T motorcycles.  The throttle wire may bend excessively and break, resulting in a loss of throttle response and an engine stall.

title: REV Recreation Group: Exterior Patio Outlet May Lack GFCI Protection (598 affected)
summary: REV Recreation Group (REV) is recalling certain 2019-2025 Holiday Rambler Admiral, 2023-2025 Holiday Rambler Eclipse, Fleetwood Flex, and 2019-2024 Fleetwood Flair motorhomes.  The exterior patio outlet may lack GFCI protection when powered by the generator or shore cord.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Left-Side Longitudinal Beam May Crack (1,150 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC. (BMW) is recalling certain 2024 i4 eDrive40, xDrive40, and M50 vehicles. The left-side longitudinal beam may crack, compromising the structural integrity of the chassis.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: High Voltage Battery May Short Circuit (12,535 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC. (BMW) is recalling certain 2020-2024 MINI Hardtop 2 Door (Cooper SE) vehicles.  Faults may occur in the high voltage battery or high voltage system, resulting in a short circuit.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Forward-Facing Camera May Become Inoperable (443 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Vista, Sunstar, and Adventurer motorhomes built on F53 chassis.  The wiring may have been incorrectly routed, damaging the forward-facing camera wiring.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Loss of Brakes from Unexpected ABS Activation (4,174 affected)
summary: Acura (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2024 Acura ZDX All-Wheel Drive vehicles.  The anti-lock brake system (ABS) may activate unexpectedly and release brake pressure in the vehicle's service brake system.

title: Tesla, Inc.: Missing Primer May Cause Roof Trim Separation (9,136 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2016 Model X vehicles.  The front and center roof cosmetic trim pieces may be adhered to the vehicle without primer.  As a result, one or both pieces of trim may separate from the vehicle.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Stowed Griddle Can Cause Fire (6 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 R-POD RPT203 travel trailers.  The exterior griddle may be stowed while still connected to LP gas line.

title: Winnebago Towable: Microwave Connected to Incorrect Circuit (210 affected)
summary: Winnebago Towable (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Minnie travel trailers.  The microwave may have been incorrectly connected to a 20 AMP breaker, allowing the wire to become overloaded.

title: Winnebago Towable: Non-GFCI Protected Outlet Installed On Countertop (1,201 affected)
summary: Winnebago Towable (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Minnie, 2024-2025 Access, and 2021-2025 Voyage travel trailers.  The countertop may have an incorrect standard outlet installed when there should be a GFCI protected outlet.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Sewer Anti-Siphon Vent Installed Backwards (25 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Puma PUT39DBT travel trailers.  The anti-siphon vent may have been installed backwards which can cause sewer gas to enter the vehicle.

title: Space Craft MFG: LED Backlight Circuit Board Failure May Cause Fire (1 affected)
summary: Space Craft MFG (Space Craft) is recalling one Suburban Slide in Range installed in a 2023 S-390 fifth-wheel trailers.  The LED backlight circuit board in the cooktop range may fail, causing the board to overheat.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Brake Pedal May Detach from Brake Booster (1,453 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2019-2024 Audi E-Tron and 2020-2024 Audi E-Tron Sportback vehicles.  The fastener that connects the brake pedal and the brake booster may have been improperly assembled during manufacturing, which can cause the brake pedal to detach from the brake booster.

title: Kalmar Solutions, LLC: Insufficient Air Volume in Brake System /FMVSS 121 (96 affected)
summary: Kalmar Solutions, LLC (Kalmar) is recalling certain 2016-2017 Ottawa T2 6X4 vehicles.  The air tanks have an insufficient volume of air for the brake system.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 121, "Air Brake Systems."

title: Northern Lite Mfg: LED Backlight Circuit Board Failure May Cause Fire (958 affected)
summary: Northern Lite Mfg (Northern Lite) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Truck Campers.  The LED backlight circuit board in the cooktop range may fail, causing the board to overheat.

title: Fisker Group Inc: Unexpected Reduction In Regenerative Braking (7,745 affected)
summary: Fisker Group Inc (Fisker) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Ocean vehicles.  The brake module software may cause an unexpected reduction in regenerative braking, decreasing the braking performance.

title: Continental Tire the Americas, LLC: Tire Shoulder Separation (462 affected)
summary: Continental Tire the Americas, LLC (Continental) is recalling certain HDL2 DL+ tires, size 11R24.5.  An incorrect rubber compound may cause the steel belt edge to separate from the shoulder.

title: Continental Tire the Americas, LLC: Tire Belt Separation (146,568 affected)
summary: Continental Tire the Americas, LLC (Continental) is recalling certain ProContact GX AO tires, size 255/35R19.  The design of the tire may cause excessive heat buildup, resulting in belt separation.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: Battery Damage from Over-Current Condition (24 affected)
summary: Motor Coach Industries (MCI) is recalling certain 2021 D45CRTeLE vehicles.  An error in the battery module software may cause an over-current condition during battery charging, resulting in battery damage.

title: ESCAPE TRAILER INDUSTRIES LTD.: LED Backlight Circuit Board Failure May Cause Fire (248 affected)
summary: Escape Trailer is recalling certain 2024 Escape 17, 19, 21, 23, and 5.0 travel trailers.  The LED backlight circuit board in the cooktop range may fail, causing the board to overheat.

title: OEM Systems, LLC: Rear Bumper Mounting Bracket Underrated for Towing (38 affected)
summary: OEM Systems, LLC (OEM) is recalling certain 2024 Chevrolet Silverado vehicles.  The rear bumper mounting bracket may not be sufficient for towing, which can allow the towed trailer to detach from the vehicle.

title: Alamo Group Inc.: Improperly Secured Electrical Wires May Cause Fire (128 affected)
summary: Alamo Group Inc. (Morbark) is recalling certain Morbark 2018-2024 EB1821, EB2131, EB2230, and M20 trailers.  The electrical wires in the Power Distribution Module (PDM) may be loose and contact the PDM plate, possibly resulting in electrical arcing between the wiring and plate.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Tire May Fail and Cause Crash (34 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024 Forest River Salem, and Wildwood travel trailers.  The tire may contact the outrigger, causing the tire to fail.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Tire May Fail and Cause Crash (132 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Salem SBF325RL, and Wildwood WBF325RL travel trailers.  The tires may contact chassis components, causing the tires to fail.

title: Endera Motors: Emergency Exit May Close Unexpectedly/FMVSS 217 (18 affected)
summary: Endera Motors (Endera) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Endera school buses.  The rear emergency exit door has a gas shock that is underrated for the weight of the door, which can result in the door closing unexpectedly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: Endera Motors: Emergency Exit Label Print Too Small/FMVSS 217 (158 affected)
summary: Endera Motors (Endera) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Endera school buses.  The emergency exit label operating instructions lettering is too small and may be difficult to read.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: McNeilus Truck & Manufacturing, Inc.: Side Loader Arm May Move While Driving (4,300 affected)
summary: McNeilus Truck & Manufacturing, Inc. (McNeilus) is recalling certain 2015-2024 Zero Radius refuse trucks.  The side loader arm may not be properly secured, resulting in unexpected movement while driving.

title: Great Dane Trailers: Improperly Welded Trailer Mounts (1,757 affected)
summary: Great Dane Trailers (Great Dane) is recalling certain 2025 Everest SS refrigerated trailers.  The support gear bracing mounts may have been welded improperly.

title: Ford Motor Company: Engine Intake Valves May Break (90,736 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Bronco, F-150, Edge, Explorer, Lincoln Nautilus, and Lincoln Aviator vehicles equipped with either a 2.7L or 3.0L Nano EcoBoost engine.  The engine intake valves may break while driving, which can result in engine failure and a loss of drive power.

title: Ford Motor Company: Fuel Injectors May Leak (24 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023 Lincoln Corsair, 2023-2024 Escape, 2024 Mustang, and 2025 Explorer vehicles.  The fuel injectors may have been assembled without O-ring support discs, which can result in a fuel leak.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: High-Voltage Battery May Overheat (2,760 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Jaguar) is recalling certain 2019 Jaguar I-PACE vehicles.  The high-voltage battery may overheat.

title: Ford Motor Company: Incorrect Gross Axle Weight Rating on Labels (373 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 Transit vehicles.  The front gross axle weight rating may be labeled incorrectly on the vehicle B-pillar label and the owner's manual label, which can result in an overloaded vehicle.

title: Navico Group: Shock Risk from Insufficient Ground Connection (21,337 affected)
summary: Navico Group is recalling certain Progressive RSM-30 and PSK-30 surge protectors, designed for use with recreational vehicles.  The ground contact in the surge protector may not properly contact the mating ground pin, causing an open ground condition.

title: GE Appliances, a Haier Company: Air Conditioner May Catch Fire (4,963 affected)
summary: GE Appliances, a Haier Company (GE Appliances) is recalling certain recreational vehicle air conditioners, equipped with a soft start device with part number ICM870-16A-BH5400.  Please see the attached 573 recall report for the full list of air conditioner models.  The air conditioner soft start device may fail and overheat.

title: USK Internacional: Loss of Steering Control from Broken Ball Stud (20,962 affected)
summary: USK Internacional (USK) is recalling certain Tie Rod and Drag Link assemblies.  The tie rod or drag link assembly may contain an improperly heat-treated ball stud, causing the ball stud to break.

title: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC): Improperly Routed Fuel Line May Cause Fire (12 affected)
summary: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Commercial Office trailers equipped with CK7G generators.  The fuel line assembly on the generator may be loose or improperly routed, which can result in a fuel leak.

title: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC): Generator Exhaust Port Failure May Cause Fire (12 affected)
summary: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Commercial Office trailers equipped with CK7G generators.  The insulated exhaust port outlet may fail, which can result in damage to other components.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Tow Hitch Cover May Detach (43,395 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Sequoia Hybrid vehicles equipped with a tow hitch cover attached to the rear bumper.  The tow hitch cover may come loose from the bumper and detach from the vehicle.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (1,245 affected)
summary: Jayco Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Entegra Ethos, Ethos LI, Arc, Jayco Swift, Swift LI, and Comet motorhomes.  The radio software may prevent the rearview image from displaying.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Kentucky Trailer Manufacturing: Upper Cargo Area Floor Improperly Secured (1,439 affected)
summary: Kentucky Trailer Manufacturing (KTM) is recalling certain 2022-2024 (KTB) MV and PV truck bodies.  The upper cargo area floor may not be secured properly, which can allow the crossmembers to loosen and detach.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Improperly Secured Passenger Air Bag Inflator (837 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (VW) is recalling certain 2023-2024 ID4 vehicles.  The fasteners securing the passenger frontal air bag inflator may be loose.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Fuel and Brake Lines May Leak (623 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2024 AT and TA series aerial devices, and ST series spray bodies.  The fuel or brake lines may not be properly secured, which can cause the lines to become damaged and leak.

title: Alltrade Tools LLC: E-Bike Rack May Fail (6,718 affected)
summary: Alltrade Tools LLC (Alltrade) is recalling all Kilimanjaro E-bike racks sold at Costco and Costco.com.  Please see the recall report for the model numbers and sizes.  The connection points may crack, which can cause the rack to fail.

title: E-One Incorporated: Engine Crossmember May Break (28 affected)
summary: E-One Incorporated (E-One) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Cyclone 2, 2022-2024 Cyclone N, and Typhoon N vehicles.  The engine crossmember may break, allowing the cooling fan to contact the fan shroud and become damaged.
